foto-01.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: CACE Imatges N1 single-word vocabulary stimulus. Intended concept: NERVIÓS. ONE synthetic studio PHOTOGRAPH. Real camera realism, believable skin texture and hair, soft even neutral studio light. No illustration or cartoon. Subject: a 12-year-old girl with light olive skin and brown bobbed hair in a plain teal T-shirt. Visual content: Nervous anticipatory tension conveyed by the human FACE: compressed uneven lips, tense jaw, uncertain wavering half-smile, slightly furrowed brow, alert uneasy eyes directed sideways. No terror gasp, no tears, not angry. No symbolic droplets, no props.  Composition: ONE square image, pure white background, isolated clear subject, Full head, ears, neck and upper shoulders, scalp entirely inside frame and white margin above it; natural portrait crop at upper chest. Human face large, directly readable. Minimal context only when essential. NO text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, emoji, decorative symbols, arrows, borders, panels, collages or montage. Anatomically plausible proportions, correct eyes and mouth, no extra limbs or fingers. Appropriate for school use and varied ages. Produce ONE standalone image only.

review.scope: Revisió visual de producció pel mateix assistent que ha preparat els prompts; no és una lectura cega ni una validació amb participants.

alt.ca: Cara amb els llavis premuts, la mandíbula tensa i la mirada inquieta cap a un costat.
alt.es: Rostro con los labios apretados, la mandíbula tensa y la mirada inquieta hacia un lado.
